RT.Psykana.Mutations.WeirdLimbs.Name: Weirdly Connected Limbs
RT.Psykana.Mutations.WeirdLimbs.Desc: Your limbs have additional joints that do not work the way an ordinary human's do. You gain the Contortionist skill as a trained Basic skill. If you already have the Contortionist skill, you instead gain the Talent (Contortionist) talent.
RT.Psykana.Mutations.StretchedForm.Name: Stretched Form
RT.Psykana.Mutations.StretchedForm.Desc: You are unusually tall and painfully thin, and you permanently lose 1d5 Toughness. Reroll this mutation if you already have the Bloated Frame mutation.
RT.Psykana.Mutations.PaleFlesh.Name: Pale and Hairless Flesh
RT.Psykana.Mutations.PaleFlesh.Desc: Your skin is pale, tinted with veins and completely devoid of hair.
RT.Psykana.Mutations.VoidEyes.Name: Void-Dark Eyes
RT.Psykana.Mutations.VoidEyes.Desc: Your eyes are completely dark and have no iris; you gain the Night Vision trait.
RT.Psykana.Mutations.WitheredFrame.Name: Withered Frame
RT.Psykana.Mutations.WitheredFrame.Desc: Your body is withered, the skin hanging straight from your bones. You permanently reduce your Strength characteristic by 10 and halve your movement distance. Reroll this mutation if you already have the Bloated Frame mutation.
RT.Psykana.Mutations.BloatedFrame.Name: Bloated Frame
RT.Psykana.Mutations.BloatedFrame.Desc: Your body is extremely corpulent and your limbs are covered in abundant flesh. You gain 5 wounds and the Hardy trait, but you can no longer run. Reroll this mutation if you already have the Stretched Form or Withered Frame mutations.
RT.Psykana.Mutations.WebbedDevelopment.D: You have skin webs between your limbs and fingers, and your skin hangs in folds: you take a -5 penalty to Fellowship.
RT.Psykana.Mutations.InhumanFace.Name: Inhuman Face
RT.Psykana.Mutations.InhumanFace.Desc: Your face is devoid of human features, your nose is little more than a pair of slits, your ears are small holes, and your eyes do not blink. You gain the Fear (1) trait.
RT.Psykana.Mutations.ClawedFingers.Name: Clawed Fingers
RT.Psykana.Mutations.ClawedFingers.Desc: The bones of your fingers have grown and hardened into claws. You gain the Natural Weapons trait.
RT.Psykana.Mutations.NeedleTeeth.Name: Needle-like Teeth
RT.Psykana.Mutations.NeedleTeeth.Desc: Your mouth is filled with hundreds of small, pointed teeth. You gain the Natural Weapons trait and a -1d5 penalty to Fellowship.
RT.Psykana.Mutations.EerieGrace.Name: Eerie Grace
RT.Psykana.Mutations.EerieGrace.Desc: You move with a fluid, writhing grace that has something unpleasant and unnatural in its nature. You gain the Unnatural Agility (×2) trait.
RT.Psykana.Mutations.StrangeVitality.Des: You possess hardiness and resilience that does not match your physical form: a translucent fluid leaks from your wounds and they close quickly, and bones knit after horrific breaks. You gain the Regeneration trait.
RT.Psykana.Mutations.UnnaturalPresence.D: In your presence living creatures feel a strange unpleasant sensation, a cloying touch on the skin, a piercing whine in their ears and a metallic taste in their mouths. All tests involving positive social interaction take a -10 penalty, while those involving intimidation or inspiring fear gain a +10 bonus.

RT.Tooltips.Fate:
Spending Fate Points
As a Free Action or Reaction, a player may spend a Fate Point to gain one of the following effects:
Re-roll one failed test once. The results of the re-roll are final.
Gain a +10 bonus to a test. This option must be chosen before the roll.
Add one Degree of Success to a test. This option may be chosen after the roll.
Count an Initiative roll result as 10.
Instantly remove 1d5 Damage (this does not affect Critical Damage).
Instantly shake off being Stunned.

Fate Points are restored each session, at the GM's discretion.

Burning Fate Points
An Explorer may reduce their Fate Points by 1 in order to survive something that would otherwise kill them, but only just barely.
A Fate Point can be burnt even if it has already been spent during the session.
RT.Tooltips.Fatigue:
Any level of fatigue imposes a -10 penalty on all tests.
Click the button to apply the penalty — it will be reflected in the characteristic values.
Click again to remove the penalty.
The fatigue limit equals the Toughness bonus.
If a character exceeds their fatigue threshold, they fall unconscious for 10 minutes minus their Toughness bonus.
RT.SkillDesc.Awareness: Passively noticing threats, ambushes and traps; opposed vs. an opponent.
RT.SkillDesc.Barter: Trade and haggling over prices; usually an opposed test.
RT.SkillDesc.Carouse: Resisting alcohol and drugs; failure risks fatigue or passing out.
RT.SkillDesc.Charm: Improving an NPC's attitude; opposed vs. Willpower.
RT.SkillDesc.Command: Giving orders to subordinates; up to the Fellowship bonus of targets.
RT.SkillDesc.Climb: Climbing walls and cliffs; tests on difficult surfaces.
RT.SkillDesc.Concealment: Hiding objects and oneself; opposed vs. the observer's Awareness.
RT.SkillDesc.Disguise: Disguising as someone else; opposed vs. Awareness.
RT.SkillDesc.Contortionist: Flexibility: escaping bonds, slipping out of grabs, squeezing through tight spaces.
RT.SkillDesc.Deceive: Lies and bluffing; opposed vs. Scrutiny.
RT.SkillDesc.Dodge: Reaction: reduce a successful attack to zero.
RT.SkillDesc.Evaluate: Determining the value and authenticity of items.
RT.SkillDesc.Gamble: Games of chance; usually opposed vs. Logic.
RT.SkillDesc.Inquiry: Gathering information from people; takes time.
RT.SkillDesc.Search: Actively searching for hidden objects and details.
RT.SkillDesc.Swim: Swimming; tests are needed in dangerous conditions.
RT.SkillDesc.Acrobatics: Acrobatic feats, balance and safe falls.
RT.SkillDesc.ChemUse: Working with chemicals, toxins and drugs.
RT.SkillDesc.Commerce: Large deals, markets and trade contracts.
RT.SkillDesc.Interrogation: Extracting information; usually opposed vs. Willpower.
RT.SkillDesc.Medicae: First aid and treatment of injuries.
RT.SkillDesc.Psyniscience: Perceiving psychic phenomena, auras and warp disturbances.
RT.SkillDesc.SleightOfHand: Pickpocketing and sleights; opposed vs. Awareness.
RT.SkillGroupDesc.Ciphers: Secret codes of organisations. A test is required to compose or decipher complex messages. Sub-skills: Rogue Traders, Mercenary Jargon, Navis House, Astropath Signs, Underworld (Int).
RT.SkillGroupDesc.CommonLore: Common knowledge of a world, culture or organisation. Sub-skills: Adeptus Arbites, Adeptus Astra Telepathica, Adeptus Mechanicus, Administratum, Ecclesiarchy, Imperial Creed, Astra Militarum, Imperial Fleet, Imperium, Koronus Expanse, Navis Nobilite, Rogue Traders, Technology, War (Int).
RT.SkillGroupDesc.Drive: Operating ground, hover and walker vehicles. Sub-skills: Ground Vehicle, Skimmer/Hover, Walker (Ag).
RT.SkillGroupDesc.ForbiddenLore: Hidden and forbidden knowledge. Sub-skills: Adeptus Mechanicus, Archeotech, Daemonology, Heresy, Inquisition, Mutants, Navigators, Pirates, Psykers, The Warp, Xenos (Int).
RT.SkillGroupDesc.Navigation: Plotting courses. Sub-skills: Surface, Stellar, Warp (Int).
RT.SkillGroupDesc.Pilot: Operating personal flight devices, aircraft and spacecraft. Sub-skills: Personal, Aircraft, Spacecraft (Ag).
RT.SkillGroupDesc.ScholasticLore: Scientific and specialised knowledge. Sub-skills: Archea, Astromancy, Imperial Creed, Tainted Pagery, Daemonology, Numerology, Politics of the Imperium, Shipbuilding, Tactics and Logistics, Technomancy (Int).
RT.SkillGroupDesc.SecretTongue: Secret tongues of castes and organisations. Sub-skills: Administratum, Ecclesiarchy, Military, Navigators, Rogue Traders, Technology, Underdeck (Int).
RT.SkillGroupDesc.SpeakLanguage: The languages of the Imperium. Sub-skills: Eldar, Explorator Binary, High Gothic, Low Gothic, Ork, Techna-Lingua, Trader's Cant (Int).
RT.SkillGroupDesc.Trade: Craft skills; the characteristic depends on the sub-skill. Sub-skills: Archeologist (Int), Armorer (Ag), Astrographer (Ag), Chemist (Int), Cryptographer (Int), Explorator (Int), Linguist (Int), Shipwright (Ag or Int), Engraver, Shipwright (Int), Soothsayer (Fel), Technomat (Int), Trader (Fel), Voidmaster (Ag).
RT.SkillGroupDesc.Special: Special skills defined by your campaign: invent a name and choose a suitable characteristic.

RT.WeaponSpecials.Accurate.Summary: +10 when Aiming; aimed single shot with a Basic weapon: +1d10 damage per 2 DoS (max +2d10).
RT.WeaponSpecials.Blast.Summary: Hits all targets within X metres; roll Hit Location and Damage per target.
RT.WeaponSpecials.CleansingFire.Summary: Targets must pass Willpower or catch fire; with Flame, extra 1d10 E ignoring Armour/TB when flames persist.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Concussive.Summary: On hit, Toughness Test (−10 per DoS) or Stunned 1 Round; high Damage vs SB can knock Prone.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Corrosive.Summary: Each hit reduces AP by 1d10 until repaired; excess below 0 AP becomes Wounds ignoring TB.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Customized.Summary: Halves Reload time if longer than a Half Action.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Crippling.Summary: After taking a Wound, further Half+ Actions deal X Rending to the same location, ignoring Armour/TB.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Daemonbane.Summary: Vs Daemonic: ignore TB and gain Vengeful (8).
RT.WeaponSpecials.DeadlySnare.Summary: As Snare, but entangled targets take the weapon’s Damage each Round until free.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Decay.Summary: Living targets that take Critical Damage must pass Toughness (−10 per X) or be destroyed.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Defensive.Summary: +15 to Parry; −10 when used to attack.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Devastating.Summary: Extra Cohesion/Magnitude loss: reduce Horde Magnitude by X per hit (as edition rules).
RT.WeaponSpecials.Disintegrate.Summary: Critical Damage from this weapon destroys the victim.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Excruciating.Summary: Damaged targets pass −10 WP or T or are Stunned for 1 Round.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Fast.Summary: Opponents take −20 to Parry this weapon.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Felling.Summary: Ignore X levels of Unnatural Toughness.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Flame.Summary: No BS Test: 30° arc Agility Tests or be hit; second Agility Test or catch fire (cover ignored).
RT.WeaponSpecials.Force.Summary: Psyker: +1 Damage/Pen per Psy Rating (type E); opposed Focus Power may add 1d10 E per DoS ignoring Armour/TB.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Gauss.Summary: Zealous Hatred on 9–10; if that would deal no Damage, deal 1d5 Wounds instead.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Graviton.Summary: Extra Damage equal to target AP; vehicle Criticals use Motive Systems.
RT.WeaponSpecials.GyroStabilised.Summary: Never counts as beyond Long Range; Heavy: unbraced penalty reduced to −20.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Hallucinogenic.Summary: Hit targets pass Toughness (−10 per X) or suffer hallucination for 1 Round + DoF.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Haywire.Summary: Everything in X metres suffers Haywire; effect steps down each Round.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Indirect.Summary: May fire without LoS at −10 as a Full Action; hits and misses scatter (see Indirect rules).
RT.WeaponSpecials.Integrated.Summary: Needs a potentia coil connection and special Weapon Training.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Irradiated.Summary: Hit targets pass Toughness (−10 per X) or take 2d10 Toughness Damage.
RT.WeaponSpecials.LivingWeapon.Summary: Extra hit for each Degree of Success on the attack.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Maximal.Summary: Optional Maximal mode: +10m Range, +1d10 Damage, +2 Pen, Blast +2 if any; uses 3× ammo and adds Recharge.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Melta.Summary: Double Penetration at Short range or closer.
RT.WeaponSpecials.OgrynProof.Summary: Usable by characters with the Clumsy trait.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Overcharge.Summary: May add X Damage and the Overheats quality when firing.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Overheats.Summary: 91+ causes Overheat (Energy Damage to the arm); cool for 1 Round; does not Jam.
RT.WeaponSpecials.PowerField.Summary: Parried or hit weapons may be destroyed on a d10 roll of 4+ (Power Fields immune).
RT.WeaponSpecials.Primitive.Summary: Armour AP counting as Primitive is doubled vs this weapon (or as edition Primitive (X) rules).
RT.WeaponSpecials.Proven.Summary: Damage dice count as at least X.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Reactive.Summary: May make a free Standard Attack when charged (once per Round).
RT.WeaponSpecials.Recharge.Summary: Cannot fire next Round after firing.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Reliable.Summary: Only Jams on a 00; ignore most other Jam triggers.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Sanctified.Summary: Counts as holy/sanctified vs relevant Daemonic and Warp foes.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Scatter.Summary: At Point Blank: +2 hits; at Short or closer: +10 to hit; beyond Short: −10 to hit.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Shocking.Summary: Damaged targets pass Toughness or are Stunned for Rounds equal to DoF.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Smoke.Summary: Creates smoke with radius X (or as listed) that blocks vision.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Snare.Summary: Hit targets pass Agility or become Immobilised; break free with Strength/Agility.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Spray.Summary: Hits all in a 30° arc out to Range; each target Tests Agility or is hit.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Storm.Summary: Double hits from Semi/Full Auto (and similar rate modes).
RT.WeaponSpecials.Tainted.Summary: Add wielder’s Corruption Bonus to Damage.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Tearing.Summary: Roll an extra Damage die and discard the lowest.
RT.WeaponSpecials.TemporalLeech.Summary: Damaged living targets lose 1 Round of actions (as listed).
RT.WeaponSpecials.Toxic.Summary: Damaged targets pass Toughness (−10 per X) or take extra Damage from toxin.
RT.WeaponSpecials.TwinLinked.Summary: +20 to hit when firing both barrels; uses twice the ammo; extra hit on 2+ DoS.
RT.WeaponSpecials.TyranidWeapon.Summary: Tyranid/living bio-weapon special rules apply as listed.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Unstable.Summary: On 91+, roll 1d10 for unstable misfire effects.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Vengeful.Summary: Confirms Righteous Fury / Zealous Hatred on X+ instead of 10.
RT.WeaponSpecials.Volatile.Summary: When destroyed or criticalled, detonates as listed.
RT.WeaponSpecials.WarpWeapon.Summary: Ignores Armour; only force fields and Warp-warding apply.
RT.WeaponSpecials.WitchEdge.Summary: Adds wielder’s Psy Rating to Damage and Penetration vs psykers/Warp entities as listed.
